# Pyntra ads.txt — authorized digital sellers (IAB ads.txt).
#
# This placeholder ships empty of seller records. To go live with Google
# AdSense, DO NOT edit this file by hand — instead set the environment variable
#   VITE_ADSENSE_CLIENT = ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
# in the Render dashboard (see render.yaml). On the next deploy the build
# overwrites this file with your real record, e.g.:
#   google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
# and injects the AdSense loader into every page. With the variable unset, the
# site shows no ads and this file stays empty.
